saints.name: St. Martin de Porres
saints.title: Religious
saints.shortBlurb: A Dominican lay brother of Lima whose charity to the poor and the sick knew no barrier of race or rank…
biography: Born at Lima in Peru in 1579, the son of a Spanish gentleman and a freed woman of African descent, Martin was apprenticed to a barber-surgeon before entering the Dominican priory of Lima as a lay helper, later becoming a professed lay brother. Humble, penitential, and tireless, he served as infirmarian and almoner, caring for the sick of every class and founding relief for the poor and for orphans.

He was famed in his own lifetime for his charity, his love of the sick and of animals, and for extraordinary graces. He died at Lima on 3 November 1639. He is a patron of those working for interracial harmony and of the poor.
saints.knownFor: Heroic charity to the poor and the sick as a Dominican lay brother.
